name: insurtech-partner-integration-sdk
description: Insurtech Partner Integration SDK Monorepo (Common DTOs, Mock API Server, and TypeScript SDK)

scripts.prepare: husky || (cd .. && husky "AI Challenge 13 — Partner Integration SDK/.husky") || true
scripts.build: yarn --cwd packages/common build && yarn --cwd packages/mock-api build && yarn --cwd packages/sdk build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && yarn --cwd packages/common typecheck && yarn --cwd packages/mock-api typecheck && yarn --cwd packages/sdk typecheck
scripts.check: yarn format:check && yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
scripts.examples: yarn example:1 && yarn example:2 && yarn example:3
